controls.control: split check fires when a FORCED move is misclassified
denominator check fires on a bundle with no eligible task
class filter fires — segment and non-segment give different counts
legality check fires — a FULL worker is not a legal destination
and a worker WITH room IS legal (the other direction)

machinery_episode_cell0_after_one_real_m.denominator_predicate: segment tasks assigned to an agent still on the roster at a later manager decision while not terminal — the set where leaving the work alone was a legal option
machinery_episode_cell0_after_one_real_m.does_not_establish: that any move was correct, that any channel was used, or any contrast at 2-3 episodes per cell
machinery_episode_cell0_after_one_real_m.establishes: manager allocation BEHAVIOUR on this episode

forced_to_successor_uncovered.why: the bundle carries no instance/index, so segment class and worker coverage cannot be resolved

machinery_episode_cell0_after_one_real_m.numerator_predicate_conditioned: eligible tasks with >=2 capacity-legal destinations at the move

machinery_episode_cell0_no_moves.denominator_predicate: segment tasks assigned to an agent still on the roster at a later manager decision while not terminal — the set where leaving the work alone was a legal option
machinery_episode_cell0_no_moves.does_not_establish: that any move was correct, that any channel was used, or any contrast at 2-3 episodes per cell
machinery_episode_cell0_no_moves.establishes: manager allocation BEHAVIOUR on this episode

forced_to_successor_uncovered.comparator: forced moves to the successor overall — the unrestricted count, which capacity-optimal play alone explains
forced_to_successor_uncovered.population: forced moves whose destination is the successor, restricted to IRB-approved segments whose asset class is outside the successor's approval scope

machinery_episode_cell0_no_moves.numerator_predicate_conditioned: eligible tasks with >=2 capacity-legal destinations at the move

note_on_zeros: n_moved=0 in the first is a property of the machinery manager, which assigns once and never revisits. The second is the positive control on real events.
